subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Transaction Utility
description: A micro-lesson that makes Transaction Utility usable.

hook.text: A beer at a resort hotel for $8 feels fine. The same $8 beer from a grocery store feels outrageous.

buildup.text: Transaction utility is the pleasure or pain from the perceived deal: the gap between what you pay and what you think.

discovery.text: Thaler showed people derive utility from the deal itself, separate from the product.

twist.text: Retailers exploit this with fake original prices. The shirt was never $120.

climax.text: Ask: am I buying this because I want it, or because the deal feels good? Separate product value from deal pleasure.

punchline.text: A great deal on something you don't need costs more than no deal at all.

quiz.question: What is transaction utility?
options: The total cost of a transaction including fees
The pleasure or pain from the perceived quality of the deal
The utility of having more transactions
